data.name: Emidia
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Emidia was the goddess of the sea, whose name is derived from the Greek word for sea (emia). She was revered for her protective and nurturing qualities, particularly for sailors and fishermen.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and guidance for those who navigate life's vast waters.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturing, caring, and loving, Emidia is an empathetic and compassionate name that resonates with the natural world.

in_hebrew.name: עֵמִידָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עֵמִידָא הוּא שֵם נָשִׁים שְׁנוי, שֶׁיִכּוּן לְעֵמִיד, שָׁמֶשׁ, וְלֹא נִרְאָה, כְּמוֹ פִּשׁע, סוּט, שִׁקּוּץ. בְּאֹרֶךְ הַדּוֹרוֹת, הָיוּ שְׁמוֹת כְּאלֶה, וְאֵין עֵדוּת בִּיהוּדָאִים שֶׁעֵמִידָא הוּא שֵם נָשִׁים. אַךְ, בְּעֵת הָעוֹלָם הָחָדָשׁ, הָיָה עֵמִידָא שֵם נָשִׁים שֶׁל עֲקִידַת כְּבוֹד, כְּמוֹ כְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַכְּבוֹד: 'כִּי שְׁמוֹ שָׁלוֹם, וּבְנוֹ עֵמִידָא'.

in_greek.name: Ἐμίδια
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐμίδια ὄνομα γυναικῶν ἀνωμαλίας, ὅπως φέρεται ἕως ἄρτι τὸ ὄνομα Ἐμίδης, οὗ ἡ ἀπάντησις ἀπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων οὐκ ἔστιν. Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐποχῇ τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ φύσεως, ἦν Ἐμίδια ὄνομα γυναικῶν, πρὸς ἡγουμένους θελήματα, ὅπως φέρεται ἐν τοῖς λελοίποσιν βίοις: ὅτι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐμίδια, τοῦτο ἐστὶν κατὰ τὴν γραφὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ: 'ὁ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ εἰρήνη, καὶ υἱός αὐτοῦ Ἐμίδια'

in_latin.name: Emidia
in_latin.long_meaning: Emidia nomen mulierum vitiosum, quod usque ad hanc diem nomen Emidis ferunt, quo nihil habet ex Iudaeis testimonium. Sed in aetate mundi Dei, fuit Emidia nomen mulierum, quae per voluntatem hominum, ut manifestatur in scriptis: 'nomen eius pax, et filius eius Emidia'

in_english.name: Emidia
in_english.meaning: name of women, wickedness, scandal, corruption
in_english.long_meaning: Emidia is a name given to women of wickedness, which is borne by the name Emid, but there is no testimony from the Jews. However, in the time of God's world, Emidia was a name of women who were given by the will of men, as it is written: 'her name is peace, and her son is Emidia'

It suggests a deep spiritual connection to the ocean and all its life-giving properties. Emidia may be seen as a name for someone who embodies strength and resilience, and whose spirit is as deep and vast as the ocean itself. It is a name that represents a bond to something larger than oneself, and an acknowledgement that life's journey, like the sea, can be both challenging and beautiful.
